name: Widow
overview: Scripture emphasizes God's special care for widows, warning His people not to afflict them, as their cries will be heard and divine judgment will follow if they are oppressed (Exodus 22:22-24). The Law also provides for the support of widows, particularly those who are daughters of priests, allowing them to eat of their father's provisions if they have no children (Leviticus 22:13). Additionally, vows made by widows are binding, underscoring their personal responsibility and standing before God (Numbers 30:9), while priests are instructed not to marry widows, highlighting distinctions in their marital eligibility (Leviticus 21:14).
